positions.title: Back End Engineer
positions.description: Scala / Play / Mongo

positions.title: Server Engineer
positions.description: Technologies used: Grails, Java 8, Groovy, Spring Boot, Gradle, Scala, Elastic Search, AWS, MySQL, Redis, Docker, RabbitMQ, Guava/Caffeine, JOOQ, Quartz, New Relic, Jenkins, Terraform.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed new features, product enhancements and software modules. Researched, prototyped and implemented product improvements utilizing technologies such as AWS (Specifically Elastic Beanstalk and RDS) and Atmosphere Async. Spearheaded development of OU Insights (linked below). Participated in continued effort to modernize technologies used in order to bring code into a modern development framework. Created, documented and improved APIs. Technologies used: Atmosphere Async, AWS, PHP, JUnit, Mockito,  Java, Tomcat, PowerMock, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, Vagrant.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Analyzed, repaired, and refactored existing unit tests, helpers and mocks. Developed new tests with a focus on speed and reliability. More than doubled test coverage in my time as an intern, while halving execution time for test suite. Discovered and fixed front end and backend bugs. Technologies used: Java, JUnit, Mockito,  Postgres and Backbone.js.

positions.title: Graduate Student Assistant
positions.description: Assisted professor Michael Soltys with research in the field of String Algorithms. Worked in small teams to tackle problems related to logic, algebra, linguistics and computational complexity.

positions.title: Project Scientist
positions.description:
Interpreted environmental data and prepared documents for submission to state regulatory bodies. Provided quality assurance for drilling programs. Assisted engineers in database management and project reporting for gravel pack and hydraulic fracturing jobs.
 
Performed field engineering work both on and off shore in California and Alaska. Developed, updated, and maintained specification sheets. Drafted and prepared pipe design models for stress and flow analysis.

Under guidance of a PE, developed and updated Lock-out/tag-out procedures for start up and shutdown of facilities.

positions.title: Media Tech
positions.description:
Provided media services for a variety of events.
Set up and operated sound systems, microphone systems, cameras and streaming video feeds.
